name: Privacy Screen Guard
description: Mask sensitive data on webpages for safer screen sharing, recordings, presentations, and screenshots. Everything runs locally.

toggle-live-privacy.description: Pause or resume Live Privacy on the current website

manual-hide.description: Choose an area to hide on the current page

rescan-page.description: Rescan the current page for sensitive information

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; connect-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'
